request: Owner requested clearer chord fingering and hand-shape guidance, especially difficult grips.
implementation: Original interactive vector diagrams and finger-by-finger steps derived from existing app chord data; optional simplified voicings preserve the same pitch classes. Original Japanese teaching summaries. No teacher images, audio, video or lyrics are copied into source or offline cache.

boundaries: Teacher videos are loaded only on their own button and never autoplay.
Opening help pauses practice/video and microphone; closing does not automatically resume.
Alternate shapes are for comparison; changing the guide does not change the exercise, capo or video position.
Guide uses right-handed guitar/left fretting-hand orientation; hand anatomy schematic is not motion capture or a universal required joint angle.
verification: The official F player played at 61 seconds and paused. B, C and common finger-placement players were also loaded, explicitly played and paused in the browser. Teacher frames are brought into view after loading/playing; late SDK completion after close cannot create a hidden player. No media files were downloaded.
